# Interactive Chapter 1 Notebook

This notebook turns the first chapter into a small laboratory. The focus is on the objects that matter early in automata theory:

- alphabets
- finite words
- languages as sets of words
- deterministic finite automata

The page is intentionally concrete. Each section lets you manipulate the definition and immediately see what changes.

## Mental Model

```{=html}
<div class="vv-grid">
  <div class="vv-card">
    <h3>Alphabet</h3>
    <p>A finite set of symbols. Example: <code>{a, b}</code>.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="vv-card">
    <h3>Word</h3>
    <p>A finite sequence built from the alphabet. Example: <code>abba</code>.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="vv-card">
    <h3>Language</h3>
    <p>A set of words sharing a property, such as “ends in <code>a</code>”.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="vv-card">
    <h3>DFA</h3>
    <p>A finite machine that reads a word left to right and decides whether that word belongs to a language.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

## 1. Alphabet and Word Playground

Use this section to build a finite alphabet and inspect the words it generates up to a bounded length.

```{=html}
<div class="vv-lab" id="alphabet-lab">
  <div class="vv-controls">
    <div class="vv-field">
      <label for="alphabet-input">Alphabet symbols</label>
      <input id="alphabet-input" type="text" value="a,b" />
    </div>
    <div class="vv-field">
      <label for="max-length-input">Maximum word length</label>
      <select id="max-length-input">
        <option value="0">0</option>
        <option value="1">1</option>
        <option value="2" selected>2</option>
        <option value="3">3</option>
        <option value="4">4</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="vv-output">
    <div class="vv-meta" id="alphabet-meta"></div>
    <div class="vv-words" id="alphabet-words"></div>
    <p class="vv-note" id="alphabet-note"></p>
  </div>
</div>
```

The key definition here is $A^*$: the set of all finite words over the alphabet $A$. The playground only shows a finite prefix of $A^*$, because the full set is infinite as soon as the alphabet is non-empty.

## 2. Language Explorer

Now fix an alphabet and choose a property. The resulting language is the set of all words satisfying that property.

```{=html}
<div class="vv-lab" id="language-lab">
  <div class="vv-controls">
    <div class="vv-field">
      <label for="language-rule">Language property</label>
      <select id="language-rule">
        <option value="ends-a">Words ending in a</option>
        <option value="even-a">Words with an even number of a's</option>
        <option value="contains-bb">Words containing bb</option>
        <option value="starts-ab">Words starting with ab</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="vv-field">
      <label for="language-max-length">Generate words up to length</label>
      <select id="language-max-length">
        <option value="1">1</option>
        <option value="2">2</option>
        <option value="3" selected>3</option>
        <option value="4">4</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="vv-output">
    <div class="vv-meta" id="language-meta"></div>
    <div class="vv-words" id="language-words"></div>
    <p class="vv-note" id="language-note"></p>
  </div>
</div>
```

This is the main shift in viewpoint: a language is not one word, but a criterion for membership.

## 3. DFA Simulator

This DFA recognizes the language

$$
L = \{ w \in \{a,b\}^* \mid w \text{ contains an even number of } a \text{'s} \}.
$$

The machine has only two states because parity is the only information it needs to remember.

```{=html}
<div class="vv-lab" id="dfa-lab">
  <div class="vv-controls">
    <div class="vv-field">
      <label for="dfa-word">Input word over {a,b}</label>
      <input id="dfa-word" type="text" value="abba" />

  </div>

  <div class="vv-button-row">
    <button class="vv-btn" id="dfa-reset">Reset</button>
    <button class="vv-btn alt" id="dfa-prev">Step Back</button>
    <button class="vv-btn alt" id="dfa-next">Step Forward</button>
    <button class="vv-btn alt" id="dfa-run">Run to End</button>
  </div>

  <div class="vv-word-track" id="dfa-track"></div>

  <div class="vv-automaton">
    <div class="vv-svg-wrap">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 460 210" width="100%" aria-label="DFA for even number of a's">
        <defs>
          <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="8" refX="9" refY="4" orient="auto">
            <polygon points="0 0, 10 4, 0 8" fill="#303036"></polygon>
          </marker>
          <marker id="arrowhead-active" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="8" refX="9" refY="4" orient="auto">

          </marker>
        </defs>

        <line x1="32" y1="105" x2="95" y2="105" class="vv-edge" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"></line>

        <path id="edge-even-odd" d="M 165 73 Q 230 24 295 73" class="vv-edge" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"></path>
        <path id="edge-odd-even" d="M 295 137 Q 230 186 165 137" class="vv-edge" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"></path>
        <path id="edge-even-loop" d="M 108 73 C 78 28, 78 182, 108 137" class="vv-edge" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"></path>
        <path id="edge-odd-loop" d="M 352 73 C 382 28, 382 182, 352 137" class="vv-edge" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"></path>

        <text x="230" y="42" class="vv-edge-label">a</text>
        <text x="230" y="173" class="vv-edge-label">a</text>
        <text x="72" y="104" class="vv-edge-label">b</text>
        <text x="388" y="104" class="vv-edge-label">b</text>

        <circle cx="130" cy="105" r="34" class="vv-state accepting" id="state-even-outer"></circle>
        <circle cx="130" cy="105" r="25" class="vv-state" id="state-even"></circle>
        <circle cx="330" cy="105" r="25" class="vv-state" id="state-odd"></circle>

        <text x="130" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700" fill="#303036">q_even</text>
        <text x="330" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700" fill="#303036">q_odd</text>
      </svg>
    </div>

    <div class="vv-panel">
      <h3>Current Configuration</h3>
      <div class="vv-meta" id="dfa-meta"></div>
      <p id="dfa-status"></p>
      <h3>Transition Trace</h3>
      <ol class="vv-log" id="dfa-log"></ol>
      <h3>Transition Table</h3>
      <table class="vv-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>State</th>
            <th>Read a</th>
            <th>Read b</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <td><code>q_even</code></td>
            <td><code>q_odd</code></td>
            <td><code>q_even</code></td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td><code>q_odd</code></td>
            <td><code>q_even</code></td>
            <td><code>q_odd</code></td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

The deterministic point should be visible here: at every step there is exactly one next state.

## Reading the Definitions Back Out of the Interaction

The notebook is useful only if the interactions map back to the formal objects.

::: {.vv-grid}
::: {.vv-card}
### $A^*$

The alphabet playground shows finite prefixes of the set of all finite words over an alphabet.
:::

::: {.vv-card}
### $L \subseteq A^*$

The language explorer separates generated words into “in the language” and “not in the language”.
:::

::: {.vv-card}
### $\delta$ and $\widehat{\delta}$

The DFA simulator applies one-symbol transitions and accumulates them over a whole input word.
:::

::: {.vv-card}
### Acceptance

The final verdict depends only on the state reached after the full word is consumed.
:::
:::

## Exercises to Try

1. In the alphabet playground, compare the number of generated words for maximum lengths 2, 3, and 4.
2. In the language explorer, check whether the empty word belongs to each sample language.
3. In the DFA simulator, try `abba`, `aaa`, `bbbb`, and the empty word.
4. Explain why the DFA only needs to remember parity, not the exact number of `a`'s.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function parseAlphabet(raw) {
    const symbols = raw
      .split(",")
      .map((part) => part.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
    return [...new Set(symbols)];
  }

  function enumerateWords(alphabet, maxLength) {
    const words = [];

    function build(prefix, remaining) {
      words.push(prefix);
      if (remaining === 0) return;
      for (const symbol of alphabet) {
        build(prefix + symbol, remaining - 1);
      }
    }

    if (alphabet.length === 0) {
      return [""];
    }

    build("", maxLength);
    return words.filter((word) => word.length <= maxLength);
  }

  function groupByLength(words) {
    const counts = new Map();
    for (const word of words) {
      const len = word.length;
      counts.set(len, (counts.get(len) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return [...counts.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  }

  function displayWord(word) {
    return word === "" ? "ε" : word;
  }

  function renderWordList(container, words, classifier) {
    container.innerHTML = "";
    for (const word of words) {
      const span = document.createElement("span");
      span.className = "vv-word";
      if (classifier) {
        span.classList.add(classifier(word) ? "accept" : "reject");
      }
      span.textContent = displayWord(word);
      container.appendChild(span);
    }
  }

  const alphabetInput = document.getElementById("alphabet-input");
  const maxLengthInput = document.getElementById("max-length-input");
  const alphabetMeta = document.getElementById("alphabet-meta");
  const alphabetWords = document.getElementById("alphabet-words");
  const alphabetNote = document.getElementById("alphabet-note");

  function updateAlphabetLab() {
    const alphabet = parseAlphabet(alphabetInput.value);
    const maxLength = Number(maxLengthInput.value);
    const words = enumerateWords(alphabet, maxLength);
    const grouped = groupByLength(words);

    alphabetMeta.innerHTML = "";
    const pills = [
      "Alphabet: {" + (alphabet.join(", ") || "∅") + "}",
      "Generated words: " + words.length,
      "Longest length shown: " + maxLength
    ];

    for (const text of pills) {
      const pill = document.createElement("span");
      pill.className = "vv-pill";
      pill.textContent = text;
      alphabetMeta.appendChild(pill);
    }

    renderWordList(alphabetWords, words);
    alphabetNote.textContent =
      "Count by length: " +
      grouped.map(([len, count]) => "length " + len + " → " + count).join(", ") +
      ". The empty word ε is always present because it belongs to A* for every alphabet.";
  }

  alphabetInput.addEventListener("input", updateAlphabetLab);
  maxLengthInput.addEventListener("change", updateAlphabetLab);
  updateAlphabetLab();

  const languageRule = document.getElementById("language-rule");
  const languageMaxLength = document.getElementById("language-max-length");
  const languageMeta = document.getElementById("language-meta");
  const languageWords = document.getElementById("language-words");
  const languageNote = document.getElementById("language-note");
  const binaryAlphabet = ["a", "b"];

  const languageDefinitions = {
    "ends-a": {
      label: "Words ending in a",
      predicate: (word) => word.endsWith("a"),
      explanation: "Acceptance depends only on the last symbol."
    },
    "even-a": {
      label: "Words with an even number of a's",
      predicate: (word) => (word.match(/a/g) || []).length % 2 === 0,
      explanation: "This is the language used by the DFA simulator below."
    },
    "contains-bb": {
      label: "Words containing bb",
      predicate: (word) => word.includes("bb"),
      explanation: "Membership means that the factor bb appears somewhere in the word."
    },
    "starts-ab": {
      label: "Words starting with ab",
      predicate: (word) => word.startsWith("ab"),
      explanation: "A language can be defined by constraints on prefixes as well."
    }
  };

  function updateLanguageLab() {
    const rule = languageDefinitions[languageRule.value];
    const maxLength = Number(languageMaxLength.value);
    const words = enumerateWords(binaryAlphabet, maxLength).sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.length !== b.length) return a.length - b.length;
      return a.localeCompare(b);
    });
    const accepted = words.filter(rule.predicate);
    const rejected = words.filter((word) => !rule.predicate(word));

    languageMeta.innerHTML = "";
    [
      "Alphabet: {a, b}",
      "Accepted: " + accepted.length,
      "Rejected: " + rejected.length
    ].forEach((text) => {
      const pill = document.createElement("span");
      pill.className = "vv-pill";
      pill.textContent = text;
      languageMeta.appendChild(pill);
    });

    renderWordList(languageWords, words, rule.predicate);
    languageNote.textContent =
      rule.label + ". " + rule.explanation +
      " Green words are in the language; red words are not.";
  }

  languageRule.addEventListener("change", updateLanguageLab);
  languageMaxLength.addEventListener("change", updateLanguageLab);
  updateLanguageLab();

  const dfaWordInput = document.getElementById("dfa-word");
  const dfaTrack = document.getElementById("dfa-track");
  const dfaMeta = document.getElementById("dfa-meta");
  const dfaStatus = document.getElementById("dfa-status");
  const dfaLog = document.getElementById("dfa-log");
  const dfaReset = document.getElementById("dfa-reset");
  const dfaPrev = document.getElementById("dfa-prev");
  const dfaNext = document.getElementById("dfa-next");
  const dfaRun = document.getElementById("dfa-run");

  const stateEven = document.getElementById("state-even");
  const stateEvenOuter = document.getElementById("state-even-outer");
  const stateOdd = document.getElementById("state-odd");
  const edgeEvenOdd = document.getElementById("edge-even-odd");
  const edgeOddEven = document.getElementById("edge-odd-even");
  const edgeEvenLoop = document.getElementById("edge-even-loop");
  const edgeOddLoop = document.getElementById("edge-odd-loop");

  const dfa = {
    start: "q_even",
    accept: new Set(["q_even"]),
    step(state, symbol) {
      if (symbol === "a") {
        return state === "q_even" ? "q_odd" : "q_even";
      }
      return state;
    }
  };

  let stepIndex = 0;

  function cleanWord(raw) {
    return raw.replace(/[^ab]/g, "");
  }

  function buildRun(word) {
    const symbols = word.split("");
    const states = [dfa.start];
    for (const symbol of symbols) {
      states.push(dfa.step(states[states.length - 1], symbol));
    }
    return { symbols, states };
  }

  function activeEdge(previousState, symbol, nextState) {
    if (symbol === "a" && previousState === "q_even" && nextState === "q_odd") return edgeEvenOdd;
    if (symbol === "a" && previousState === "q_odd" && nextState === "q_even") return edgeOddEven;
    if (symbol === "b" && previousState === "q_even" && nextState === "q_even") return edgeEvenLoop;
    if (symbol === "b" && previousState === "q_odd" && nextState === "q_odd") return edgeOddLoop;
    return null;
  }

  function setEdgeActive(edge, active) {
    edge.classList.toggle("active", active);
    edge.setAttribute("marker-end", active ? "url(#arrowhead-active)" : "url(#arrowhead)");
  }

  function updateDfaLab() {
    const clean = cleanWord(dfaWordInput.value);
    if (clean !== dfaWordInput.value) {
      dfaWordInput.value = clean;
    }

    const run = buildRun(clean);
    if (stepIndex > run.symbols.length) {
      stepIndex = run.symbols.length;
    }

    const currentState = run.states[stepIndex];
    const accepted = stepIndex === run.symbols.length && dfa.accept.has(currentState);

    dfaTrack.innerHTML = "";
    if (run.symbols.length === 0) {
      const epsilon = document.createElement("span");
      epsilon.className = "vv-symbol current";
      epsilon.textContent = "ε";
      dfaTrack.appendChild(epsilon);
    } else {
      run.symbols.forEach((symbol, index) => {
        const chip = document.createElement("span");
        chip.className = "vv-symbol";
        if (index < stepIndex) chip.classList.add("done");
        if (index === stepIndex) chip.classList.add("current");
        chip.textContent = symbol;
        dfaTrack.appendChild(chip);
      });
    }

    dfaMeta.innerHTML = "";
    [
      "Current state: " + currentState,
      "Processed symbols: " + stepIndex + "/" + run.symbols.length,
      "Accepting state: " + (dfa.accept.has(currentState) ? "yes" : "no")
    ].forEach((text) => {
      const pill = document.createElement("span");
      pill.className = "vv-pill";
      pill.textContent = text;
      dfaMeta.appendChild(pill);
    });

    dfaStatus.textContent =
      stepIndex === run.symbols.length
        ? accepted
          ? "The full word has been consumed and the automaton is in q_even, so the word is accepted."
          : "The full word has been consumed and the automaton is in q_odd, so the word is rejected."
        : "Step forward to consume the next symbol and apply the transition function.";

    dfaLog.innerHTML = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < stepIndex; i += 1) {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      item.textContent =
        "Read " + run.symbols[i] + ": " + run.states[i] + " → " + run.states[i + 1];
      dfaLog.appendChild(item);
    }
    if (stepIndex === 0) {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      item.textContent = "Start in q_even before reading any symbol.";
      dfaLog.appendChild(item);
    }

    stateEven.classList.toggle("active", currentState === "q_even");
    stateEvenOuter.classList.toggle("active", currentState === "q_even");
    stateOdd.classList.toggle("active", currentState === "q_odd");

    [edgeEvenOdd, edgeOddEven, edgeEvenLoop, edgeOddLoop].forEach((edge) => {
      setEdgeActive(edge, false);
    });

    if (stepIndex > 0) {
      const edge = activeEdge(run.states[stepIndex - 1], run.symbols[stepIndex - 1], run.states[stepIndex]);
      if (edge) {
        setEdgeActive(edge, true);
      }
    }

    dfaPrev.disabled = stepIndex === 0;
    dfaNext.disabled = stepIndex === run.symbols.length;
    dfaRun.disabled = stepIndex === run.symbols.length;
  }

  dfaWordInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
    stepIndex = 0;
    updateDfaLab();
  });

  dfaReset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stepIndex = 0;
    updateDfaLab();
  });

  dfaPrev.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stepIndex = Math.max(0, stepIndex - 1);
    updateDfaLab();
  });

  dfaNext.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const max = cleanWord(dfaWordInput.value).length;
    stepIndex = Math.min(max, stepIndex + 1);
    updateDfaLab();
  });

  dfaRun.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stepIndex = cleanWord(dfaWordInput.value).length;
    updateDfaLab();
  });

  updateDfaLab();
})();
</script>
```
